title: [29.X]-Modifying Description resets Quantity to 1 on Purchase Invoice Lines
summary: Fixed an issue in the Dutch (NL) version on 29.x where editing the Description on purchase invoice or credit memo subform lines reset the Quantity to 1. A test was added.
key_points: Editing Description on purchase invoice and credit memo lines reset Quantity to 1
Fix is in the NL layer subform pages for purchase invoices and credit memos
Test added in the NL local test codeunit
